purpose: Trace a003 shoulder-girdle landmarks back to their generator so mesh-derived measurements and hard-coded provisional offsets are not mistaken for anatomical evidence.

SC.inputs: jugular-notch surface-derived landmark plus fixed offsets
SC.consequence: bilateral SC breadth is exactly 50 mm by construction; it is not an independently measured anatomical SC breadth.

AC.inputs: old mesh lateral-acromion skin point plus fixed 22 mm medial / 12 mm inferior offsets
AC.consequence: AC breadth inherits the old broad shoulder mesh and an unsourced fixed offset.

AA.inputs: old mesh lateral-acromion skin point plus fixed offsets
AA.consequence: AA inherits the old shoulder surface breadth.

TS.expression: interpolation from hard-coded [side*0.045,0.150,1.470] and [side*0.080,0.155,1.320], then -15 mm Y
TS.consequence: TS is not fitted to a measured scapular-spine root.

AI.consequence: AI is not fitted to a measured inferior-angle landmark.

GH.expression: mean x/y of three GH methods; z from acromion-depth chain
GH.consequence: local GH depth has independent support, but lateral position still depends partly on the old shoulder geometry.

implications: The current 50 mm bilateral SC breadth cannot be used as evidence for the canonical target; it is simply 2×25 mm from a hard-coded generator offset.
The a003 AC and AA lateral positions are contaminated by the old mesh breadth, so they are useful for diagnosing the old fit but not for setting the new target.

The a003 TS and AI are provisional constants rather than measured scapular landmarks. Their failure against CT morphometry confirms the a003 reference geometry is not freeze-ready, but the exact amount of mesh correction must come from the new landmark model rather than subtracting a003 coordinates mechanically.
This provenance strengthens the skeleton-first policy: the new SC/AC/AA/TS/AI frame must be generated from anatomical constraints first, and only then should the mesh be changed.
required_generator_change_for_canonical_: remove fixed ±25 mm SC placement as a target rule
remove fixed 22 mm AC medial offset from mesh acromion as a target rule
consume selected canonical SC/clavicle/scapula landmark data from a machine-readable target file
retain old a003 logic only for immutable baseline reproduction
production_safety: Do not edit character_fit.py baseline logic in place if it is needed to reproduce a003. Implement the skeleton-first target as a new revision/path so the audit baseline remains reproducible.
